refinements.name: 骑士仪典
refinements.description:
装备者的[普通攻击]和[强化特殊技]的重击命中敌人时，获得1层[兵锋]，使暴击伤害提升32%，持续25秒；[兵锋]最多叠加2层，且每种招式类型最多提供1层，重复触发时，刷新所有[兵锋]持续时间；
拥有2层[兵锋]时，获得[彻骨]：装备者造成的伤害无视目标20%冰属性伤害抗性。
refinements.descriptionEn:
When the equipper's Basic Attack or EX Special Attack's heavy attack hits an enemy, they gain 1 stack of Battle Edge, increasing CRIT DMG by 32% for 25s. Battle Edge can stack up to 2 times, and each skill type can provide up to 1 stack. Repeated triggers refresh the duration of all Battle Edge.
At 2 stacks of Battle Edge, the equipper gains Bonechill: Their DMG ignores 20% of the target's Ice RES.

basic.name: 普通攻击：凛冽枪尖
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动至多四段斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]第四段视为[出枪式]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Ice DMG.
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.

special.name: 特殊技：冰花
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动三段刺击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs three forward thrusts, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：乱琼
ex.trigger: 能量足够且不处于[巡空枪势]状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy and while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够且不处于[巡空枪势]状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力连续刺击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[强化特殊技：乱琼]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy and while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：回马枪
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
凝聚寒冰在枪头对前方进行强力反击，造成冰属性伤害；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[闪避反击：回马枪]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式视为[出枪式]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Condenses frost around the spearhead before unleashing a powerful counterattack, dealing Ice DMG.
When performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Dodge Counter: Counterthrust retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：冰凌卷地
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿刺，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，获得[砥砺]，使后续[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成的伤害提升20%，持续50秒；
当本招式第一次命中处于失衡状态下的精英或首领级敌人时，会记录并重置当前[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数，同时进入[破阵]状态，
[破阵]状态下，[巡空枪势]持续时间不会减少，长按 【普通攻击键】 可连续释放[普通攻击：敛枪式]第一段至第三段；发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段后结束[破阵]状态，并将[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数恢复；
从失衡状态恢复前[破阵]状态对同一目标最多触发一次。
招式视为[出枪式]；
[破阵]状态期间[普通攻击：敛枪式]命中失衡状态下的敌人不会开启连携窗口；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Basic Attack: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s.
When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is recorded and then reset before entering the Formation Breaker state. While in Formation Breaker, Aerial Patrol Spear's duration will not be reduced. Hold [Basic Attack] to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. After activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, Formation Breaker ends and Basic Attack: Converging Spear's stage is restored to the recorded stage.
Formation Breaker can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
While in the Formation Breaker state, Basic Attack: Converging Spear does not trigger the Chain Attack window when hitting Stunned enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：霜天
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
凝聚极寒之力对前方发动毁灭性的连续突进，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：巡戍铁卫
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:

quickAssist.descriptionEn:

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：凛然不侵
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：冰饕
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:

assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Swings the spear upward before following with a powerful downward attack, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]第四段、[强化特殊技：乱琼]、[强化特殊技：碎玉]、[支援突击：冰饕]、[连携技：冰凌卷地]、[终结技：霜天]与[闪避反击：回马枪]视为[出枪式]；
希格莉德的任意[出枪式]命中敌人时，若当前未处于[巡空枪势]状态，则进入[巡空枪势]状态，获得1次[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会，最多储存1次；
处于[巡空枪势]状态下，希格莉德发动任意[出枪式]命中敌人时，可刷新[巡空枪势]状态，并获得1次[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会，最多储存1次；
触发或刷新[巡空枪势]时，其持续时间随[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数提升而缩短：一/二/三段时，持续时间分别为8/7/6秒；
[巡空枪势]状态结束时，[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数降低一段；
激活或刷新[巡空枪势]状态时，希格莉德的暴击率提升66%，持续8秒；重复触发时持续时间延长8秒，最多不超过40秒；
处于[巡空枪势]状态下，希格莉德攻击命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，对目标造成伤害的失衡易伤倍率提升20%。
facts.textEn:
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade, EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade, Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost, Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice, Ultimate: Frozen Heavens, and Dodge Counter: Counterthrust are considered Unbridled Spear attacks.
Whenever Sigrid hits an enemy with any Unbridled Spear in combat while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, she enters the Aerial Patrol Spear state and gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, when Sigrid hits an enemy with an Unbridled Spear skill, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed and she gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
When triggering or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear, its duration decreases as the stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases. At stage 1/2/3, its duration is 8/7/6s.
When Aerial Patrol Spear ends, the stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is reduced by one, to a minimum of stage 1.
Activating or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear increases Sigrid's CRIT Rate by 66% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.
When Sigrid hits a Stunned enemy while in Aerial Patrol Spear, the Stun DMG Multiplier of her DMG dealt to the target is increased by 20%.

cinema.name: 很久很久以前
cinema.description: 发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段时，获得[巡空枪势]和一次发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]的机会；[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会溢出时，下一次[普通攻击：敛枪式]的最后一击额外造成100%攻击力的冰属性伤害；希格莉德自身攻击力提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, enters the Aerial Patrol Spear and gains 1 additional activation of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. When activations exceed the stored Basic Attack: Converging Spear's activation limit, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear's final hit deals an additional 100% of ATK as Ice DMG. Sigrid's ATK increases by 25%.

cinema.name: 传说的第一幕
cinema.description: [出枪式]和[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成伤害的穿透率提升24%；[巡空枪势]效果的持续时间延长2秒；希格莉德的喧响值获取效率提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: PEN Ratio of Unbridled Spear attacks and Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases by 24%. The duration of Aerial Patrol Spear is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.

cinema.name: 奇迹守护者

There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the Formation Breaker state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice. Formation Breaker state's Basic Attack: Converging Spear will activate faster.

处于[巡空枪势]状态，并有[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动次数时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
按当前分支段数发动对应[普通攻击：敛枪式]，造成冰属性伤害；
[普通攻击：敛枪式]共有三段，每次释放都可以使段数提升，发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段后重置段数；
[普通攻击：敛枪式]第一、二段蓄力架势期间受到敌方攻击时，希格莉德会用盾牌进行格挡，若格挡成功，抵挡此次攻击伤害，使下一次[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成的失衡值提升100%，刷新[巡空枪势]状态，并获得一次[普通攻击：敛枪式]发动机会；格挡成功后点按 【普通攻击键】 可发动对应段数的[普通攻击：敛枪式]；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[普通攻击：敛枪式]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式发动期间受到的伤害减少60%；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升;
[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state and Basic Attack: Converging Spear can be used, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches the corresponding Basic Attack: Converging Spear based on the current stage, dealing Ice DMG.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, it resets to the first stage.
If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear deals 100% more Daze, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed, and she gains one use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. Press [Basic Attack] after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable during the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：逐风
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行劈斩，造成物理属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Performs a forward cleaving slash, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：冰花
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动三段刺击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs three forward thrusts, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：乱琼
ex.description:
能量足够且不处于[巡空枪势]状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力连续刺击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
衔接在[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]后的[强化特殊技：乱琼]可以保留[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]的段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy and while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：碎玉
ex.description:
能量足够且处于[巡空枪势]状态时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：

招式视为[出枪式]；

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.

ultimate.name: 终结技：霜天
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
凝聚极寒之力对前方发动毁灭性的连续突进，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式视为[出枪式]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：巡戍铁卫
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方凝冰突进，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Condenses ice before lunging forward, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

159100001.name: 普通攻击：凛冽枪尖
159100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动至多四段斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
[普通攻击：凛冽枪尖]第四段视为[出枪式]。
159100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Ice DMG.
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.

159100009.name: 连携技：冰凌卷地
159100009.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿刺，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，获得[砥砺]，使后续[普通攻击：敛枪式]造成的伤害提升20%，持续50秒；
当本招式第一次命中处于失衡状态下的精英或首领级敌人时，会记录并重置当前[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数，同时进入[破阵]状态，
[破阵]状态下，[巡空枪势]持续时间不会减少，长按 【普通攻击键】 可连续释放[普通攻击：敛枪式]第一段至第三段；发动[普通攻击：敛枪式]第三段后结束[破阵]状态，并将[普通攻击：敛枪式]段数恢复；
从失衡状态恢复前[破阵]状态对同一目标最多触发一次。
招式视为[出枪式]；
[破阵]状态期间[普通攻击：敛枪式]命中失衡状态下的敌人不会开启连携窗口；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
159100009.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Basic Attack: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s.
When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is recorded and then reset before entering the Formation Breaker state. While in Formation Breaker, Aerial Patrol Spear's duration will not be reduced. Hold [Basic Attack] to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. After activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, Formation Breaker ends and Basic Attack: Converging Spear's stage is restored to the recorded stage.
Formation Breaker can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
While in the Formation Breaker state, Basic Attack: Converging Spear does not trigger the Chain Attack window when hitting Stunned enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
